notes: Open tasks T0020,T0018,T0015,T0041,T0019,T0046 reviewed. Six named searches across Reddit, Wowhead, Warcraft Wiki, GitHub and CurseForge. No NEW independent original per-cast hit-count or zero-inclusive histogram study identified. Bugy table provides per-ore averages and 2000/100 nominal input quantities (rank not independently established); never treat those averages as P(hit) or assume completed casts after Resourcefulness. Original ProspectMate is a potential future export source, not itself a measured cohort. Independent GitHub item-rank reference confirms Serevite 190395=R1,190396=R2,190394=R3, but this mapping was already noted in prior research and is not new measured yield. Prismatic Ore 194545 is secondary prospectable input, not an independent output cohort. No new drop records; output IDs 192837-192844 and 198412-198414 remain queue leads, not newly validated pairs.
